messages:
kevin: Heads-up, opened a short docs PR to clarify how small embedding calls get rounded in tiered metering and added an SDK hint example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4876

mira: Thanks! Is this the same rounding issue customers hit last month where lots of tiny calls looked more expensive than expected?

kevin: Same class of issue but different trigger. When requests are grouped into transient micro-batches by the serving runtime, metering currently sums per-batch units then applies tier rounding. For workloads that expect per-call billing, this can be surprising.

tara: Can you paste the minimal repro and the code snippet you want in the docs so I can do copy edits?

kevin: Sure. Repro summary in the PR: 5 near-simultaneous single-vector embedding requests -> server groups them into 2 micro-batches -> meter computes units per micro-batch -> rounding applied -> billed units != sum(per-call rounded). I added a short table showing the math plus a remediation section.

mira: Nice. What remediation do we recommend? Add a snippet for the SDK and a console panel name?

kevin: Recommendation: if you need strictly per-call accounting, either use the bulk/batch API that guarantees per-request counting, or pass the header `x-redwood-billing-intent: per-call` to opt out of batch-level rounding. Added Node + Python examples in the PR. Node example:

```js
// prefer per-call billing semantics
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-redwood-billing-intent': 'per-call'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'embed-small', input: ['a','b','c'] })
});
```

kevin: I also added a short SDK example showing how to set the header via the JS SDK and a one-liner for curl.

anika: We recently renamed the console panel — current docs reference "Metering > Tiered Usage" which is wrong. Console now shows "Billing > Cost & Usage > Tiered metering". Can you update the link and mention the panel full path?

kevin: Done. PR updated to say: "See Billing > Cost & Usage > Tiered metering (panel: Tiering by unit type)" and I fixed the link to the new console route.

tara: Small style nits: change heading "Workarounds" -> "When to use per-call billing" and make the table narrower. Also replace the term "opt out" with "request per-call semantics".

mira: Quick question for runtime: if header is present does the runtime always honor it or is it a hint? We should be explicit whether billing can still aggregate for efficiency.

kevin: It's an instruction to the metering actor; staging confirmed it tags the request and the meter keeps per-call counts. There is still an escape hatch if autoscaling merges streams, but that's rare. Filing follow-up: RUNTIME-811 to log the billing-intent header into metering events for audit.

docs-bot: PR opened by kevin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4876 — labels: docs, metering, sdk-snippet.

anika: Assigning reviewers: @tara for copy, @mira for UX/console link. Can we target merge before Friday deploy? This affects a few customers.

kevin: I added a short changelog blurb and a note in the migration guide about panel renames. Ready for review. :thumbsup:

tara: Reviewing now; should be quick. If everything looks good I'll merge EOD.

mira: I'll sanity-check the repro math and the console link after lunch.

kevin: Thanks all, leaving thread open for any last-minute edits.
